<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/medical-procedure">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Procedure" name="Puncture and catheter placement" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Procedure" name="Begin procedure" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareImplements" name="Prepare implements" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WashHands" name="Wash hands" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SterileClothes" name="Get in sterile clothes" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CleanPunctureArea" name="Clean puncture area" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DrapePunctureZone" name="Drape puncture zone" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" name="Configure ultrasound" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GelProbe" name="Put gel in probe" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CoverProbe" name="Cover probe" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SterileGel" name="Put sterile gel" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PositionProbe" name="Position probe" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PositionPatient" name="Position patient" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" name="Choose vein identification method" gatewayDirection="Diverging" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnatomicIdentification" name="Identify vein anatomically" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DopplerIdentification" name="Identify vein using Doppler" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompressionIdentification" name="Identify vein by compression" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IdentificationMerge" name="Continue after vein identification" gatewayDirection="Converging" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnesthetizePatient" name="Anesthetize patient" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Puncture" name="Puncture patient" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBloodReturn" name="Check blood return" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BloodReturnDecision" name="Is blood return correct?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DropProbe" name="Drop probe" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveSyringe" name="Remove syringe" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallGuidewire" name="Install guidewire" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveTrocar" name="Remove trocar" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" name="Choose wire check axis" gatewayDirection="Diverging" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" name="Check wire in long axis" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" name="Check wire in short axis" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WireCheckMerge" name="Continue after wire check" gatewayDirection="Converging" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWirePosition" name="Check whether wire is in good position" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WirePositionDecision" name="Is wire in good position?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WidenPathway" name="Widen pathway" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdvanceCatheter" name="Advance catheter" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RemoveGuidewire" name="Remove guidewire" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VerifyFlowReflow" name="Verify flow and reflow" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" name="Check catheter position" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Procedure" name="Procedure complete" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Procedure" targetRef="Task_PrepareImplements" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_PrepareImplements" targetRef="Task_WashHands" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_WashHands" targetRef="Task_SterileClothes" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_SterileClothes" targetRef="Task_CleanPunctureArea" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CleanPunctureArea" targetRef="Task_DrapePunctureZone" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_DrapePunctureZone" targetRef="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureUltrasound" targetRef="Task_GelProbe" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_GelProbe" targetRef="Task_CoverProbe" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_CoverProbe" targetRef="Task_SterileGel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SterileGel" targetRef="Task_PositionProbe" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PositionProbe" targetRef="Task_PositionPatient" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PositionPatient" targetRef="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identification_Anatomic" sourceRef="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" targetRef="Task_AnatomicIdentification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${identificationMethod == 'anatomic'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identification_Doppler" sourceRef="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" targetRef="Task_DopplerIdentification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${identificationMethod == 'doppler'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identification_Compression" sourceRef="Gateway_IdentificationSplit" targetRef="Task_CompressionIdentification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${identificationMethod == 'compression'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_AnatomicIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_IdentificationMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_DopplerIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_IdentificationMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_CompressionIdentification" targetRef="Gateway_IdentificationMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_IdentificationMerge" targetRef="Task_AnesthetizePatient" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_AnesthetizePatient" targetRef="Task_Puncture" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_Puncture" targetRef="Task_CheckBloodReturn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_CheckBloodReturn" targetRef="Gateway_BloodReturnDecision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BloodIncorrect" name="Not correct" sourceRef="Gateway_BloodReturnDecision" targetRef="Task_Puncture">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bloodReturnCorrect == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BloodCorrect" name="Correct" sourceRef="Gateway_BloodReturnDecision" targetRef="Task_DropProbe">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bloodReturnCorrect == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_DropProbe" targetRef="Task_RemoveSyringe" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_RemoveSyringe" targetRef="Task_InstallGuidewire" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_InstallGuidewire" targetRef="Task_RemoveTrocar" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_RemoveTrocar" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireCheck_Long" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckWireLongAxis">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wireCheckAxis == 'long'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireCheck_Short" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckWireShortAxis">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wireCheckAxis == 'short'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_CheckWireLongAxis" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_CheckWireShortAxis" targetRef="Gateway_WireCheckMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_WireCheckMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckWirePosition" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_CheckWirePosition" targetRef="Gateway_WirePositionDecision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireBadPosition" name="Not in good position" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePositionDecision" targetRef="Task_Puncture">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wireInGoodPosition == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WireGoodPosition" name="In good position" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePositionDecision" targetRef="Task_WidenPathway">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wireInGoodPosition == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_WidenPathway" targetRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter" targetRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire" targetRef="Task_VerifyFlowReflow" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_VerifyFlowReflow" targetRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" targetRef="EndEvent_Procedure" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
